title: Pass authored bilingual aliases to the existing personal-discovery ranker

scope.subject: Use authoring's already validated aliases in the existing canonical Personal destination metadata, retaining current tag search and exact-ID precedence

research_summary: The exact #176 integration candidate builds and links canonical and legacy personal destinations, but a production-navigation probe against the real native catalog found no results for independently authored English and Chinese aliases. The current Personal destination constructor populates its aliases only from tags. Reuse the pinned catalog navigation and existing ranking/normalization, taken with Astro's canonical content metadata and existing authoring alias derivation. The gap is an input projection, not a missing search system.

sources.finding: The existing YEIS-backed product keeps native target identities and the vendored normalization/catalog substrate. Authoring only contributes aliases as metadata.
The existing Content Collection is the typed source of the validated bilingual aliases; keep one authoring identity and data source rather than creating a second Search index.

search_ladder.conclusion: Use the existing integrated YEIS navigator verbatim for rank weights, normalization, catalogue retrieval and exact canonical ID precedence.
No new framework or service belongs between Astro's server-rendered content and the existing browser destination metadata.
Reuse the canonical collection and the existing locale-aware authoring alias helper. Their output can be joined with existing searchable tags without new schema or storage.
A separate index/fuzzy component would duplicate the current ranker and is unnecessary for exact authored aliases.

candidates.reason: Already resolves legacy/deep links and ranks canonical results. Pass additional metadata through the built-in alias path instead of changing rank policy.

candidates.source: Current portfolio collection and project-owned authoring metadata adapter

candidates.reason: Keeps explicit aliases and localized titles on one validated record and preserves existing tag retrieval with a narrow deduplication adapter.

decision.rationale: Feed canonical authored aliases and localized titles plus unchanged tags to the existing Personal destination aliases field. Do not change normalization, scores, native targets, legacy identity handling, or other product paths.
decision.fallback: If larger portfolios eventually require an optimization, measure it through existing product search and preserve the same canonical content record and ranking semantics rather than building a separate index now.
